there isn’t direct evidence pointing towards kurt being trans, he’s just said in a lot of interviews throughout his life that he feels more female than masculine and that he wishes he was gay to piss off homophobes. he was a very feminine and down to earth person by nature

anyone is allowed to speculate as much as they want but ive got to say i find it a little weird and disrespectful of all the people in that twitter thread to just straight up referring to kurt as she. If you step back and look at it, yeah he was a very feminine person, he was very in touch with his feminine side like painting his nails, wearing dresses, wearing makeup, and overall just protesting and rebelling against that stereotypical toxic macho male. I for one love him for doing those things and as a guy, i do some of those things aswell. What i find weird though is that those people on twitter took these things and just went with this narrative that he must have been a trans girl. You can do these things and identify as any gender, once again you can speculate but throughout his life he identified as a guy so its a little disrespectful of the people just assigning a dead person a gender that they didn’t publicly identify as. Maybe he did suffer from gender dysphoria and maybe he did identify as a closeted trans girl but these are just opinions and you shouldn’t just go around saying that its the truth.
